title: Teach Me Your Kind Way
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song of love and praise was sung,
'Lord, You are good and kind,
You forgive all who call on You,
Please teach my heart and mind.'

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father is so good,
He helps me be good too,
I ask Him, 'Teach me,' and each day
My love grows big and true.

[Verse 2]
He wanted to be like the Lord,
So patient, kind, and good,
He asked the Lord to help him grow,
And God said that He would.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and ask Him, 'Lord,
Please teach me Your good way,'
He'll fill your heart with love tonight,
And grow you day by day.

[Chorus]
mood: Growing music. A gentle, upward-leaning sway, like a small plant turning toward the sun a little more each day, matching a story about asking God to teach us His kind way. The pulse is soft and hopeful, patient rather than eager. By the last verse it settles lower and slower, the lean becoming a rest, as the asking turns into sleep.
